headers.//: The /app strangler build (wargames/15) needs none of root's third-party origins: no GSAP CDN, no PostHog, and no inline scripts (a Vite build has none). Root's rule above is deliberately NOT edited — this block is appended so that whichever precedence Vercel applies, root keeps exactly the policy it has today. /app is only ever equal to or tighter than root. This makes the beta's 'zero analytics' promise enforced at the header layer instead of merely tested; script-src has no host that could serve an analytics bundle, and connect-src has nowhere to send one.
